instrument.spec_source: Binance exchangeInfo XAUUSDT (Phase 0 verification 2026-10-30, project doc data-sources-binance.md). fapi exchangeInfo is HTTP 451 from the cloud host; re-verify with `discover` from a permitted host. Phase 3 independently confirms every price/qty in the dataset is an exact multiple.

replay._doc: availability_ms = <time_col> + time_offset_ms + latency_ms. Ties on availability_ms are broken by rank (lower first), then by the stream's sequence (partition date, row order from Phase 3 sorting).

klines_1m.why: a 1m candle is only known once its minute has closed: close_time (xx:59.999) + 1 ms

metrics.why: 5-min OI/ratio stats stamped at create_time; Binance publication delay unknown -> set latency_ms to be conservative

bookDepth.why: depth-band snapshot stamped at the time it was taken

aggTrades.why: duplicates the trades flow; off by default

trades.why: individual executions at exchange trade time

processing._doc: Phase 5 trade processor (docs/PROCESSING_V1.md). Volume in integer lots (0.001 oz), price in integer ticks (0.01 USDT).

inferred_side._doc: only splits UNKNOWN-side volume into separate INFERRED columns; never mixed into exchange-reported buy/sell

sessions._doc: Session calendar v1. STATUS: PROPOSED defaults from the build guide; decision D4 (which sessions, IB window) is still open. Times are local wall-clock in the named zone; DST via zoneinfo.

trading_day._doc: CME/COMEX convention: trading day D = 18:00 New York on D-1 -> 18:00 on D

regular_trading_week_utc._doc: Binance tradingSchedule COMMODITY REGULAR (re-verify against /fapi tradingSchedule from a permitted host). Outside it bars are flagged weekend=true.

volume_profile._doc: Phase 6 profile engine (docs/METRICS_PROFILE_V1.md). Volumes in lots, prices in ticks. Fractions are decimal strings so they are exact. Node and VA parameters are v1 defaults: PROPOSED until reviewed (see the Phase 6 report).

value_area._doc: pair = CBOT-style two-bin expansion (default); single = one bin at a time

nodes._doc: integer Gaussian smoothing (sigma = smooth_bins bins); peaks need prominence >= prom_frac * max(smoothed); HVN smoothed >= hvn_min_vol_frac * mean bin volume, LVN <= lvn_max_vol_frac * mean

orderflow._doc: Phase 7 orderflow engine (docs/METRICS_ORDERFLOW_V1.md). Volumes in lots, prices in ticks. Fractions are decimal strings so they are exact. Every detector parameter is a v1 default: PROPOSED until reviewed (see docs/PHASE7_COMPLETION_REPORT.md).

cvd._doc: CVD = running exchange-reported delta, reset at the start of every instance of each listed window kind

imbalance._doc: diagonal: buy(p) vs sell(p-1 bin); min_lots 2000 = 2 oz; zero_policy none = never an imbalance against an empty bin

big_trades._doc: taker order = consecutive fills, same side, same ms, price moving with the aggressor by <= max_step_ticks. Big if ANY enabled threshold passes.

auction._doc: Phase 9 Auction Market Theory (docs/METRICS_AUCTION_V1.md). Levels come from the final Phase 6 profile of the previous instance of each source window. Every threshold is a v1 default: PROPOSED (decision D12).

acceptance._doc: 15 consecutive 1m closes beyond, or a close beyond with volume beyond >= 10 % of the source window's volume

holidays._doc: Gold (CME/COMEX) holiday calendar, local dates in America/New_York. STATUS: PROPOSED. The dates are the 2026 US federal holidays and Good Friday; verify each date and its trading hours against CME Group's published holiday schedule before relying on it. CLOSED = no IB is built; MODIFIED_HOURS = IB built and labelled. Labels only: Phase 5 sessions are not changed.

initial_balance._doc: Phase 10 Initial Balance (docs/METRICS_IB_V1.md). Each IB lies inside a Phase 5 session: 'offset' from the session start or local 'start' in the session's time zone. STATUS: PROPOSED (decision D4).

ivb._doc: IVB is DISABLED until its definition is supplied and signed off (decision D1). It is never replaced by IB or another metric.

strategies._doc: Phase 11 research strategies (docs/SIGNALS_V1.md). None is assumed profitable; parameters are PROPOSED (D13). Signals are proposals in Binance ticks, not orders.

broker._doc: Execution venue (decision D2, OPEN): your MT5 broker's XAUUSD contract specification. A backtest refuses to run while name is null. Copy every value from the broker's contract specification (MT5: Symbols -> XAUUSD -> Specification); server_tz is the broker server time zone used by its tick timestamps.

backtest._doc: Phase 12 execution model and risk limits (docs/BACKTEST_V1.md). PROPOSED defaults; risk limits are decision D7.

research._doc: Phase 13 research (docs/RESEARCH_V1.md). Splits are fixed before any testing; the test period is opened once (data/research/test_lock.json). Approval thresholds are PROPOSED; you set the final numbers (D8), and max_oos_drawdown must be set before anything can be approved.

live._doc: Phase 14 live ingestion (docs/LIVE_V1.md). Trade source: REST polling of individual trades incl. RPI (decision D3, option a), the same definition as the history. Paper mode: signals only. Run where fapi is reachable (not a US host: HTTP 451).

venues._doc: Phase 15 venues (docs/VENUES_V1.md). One mapping record per venue; venues are separate markets and are never merged. Defaults (tick, step, ounces per quantity unit, session, price basis, specification source) live in goldflow/venues/mapping.py; override per venue here, e.g. {"bybit": {"tick_size": "0.01"}}.

bridge._doc: Phase 16 MT5 execution bridge (docs/EXECUTION_V1.md). Python listens on loopback; the EA (mt5/GoldflowExecutor.mq5) connects. The shared secret is never in this file: secret_file (e.g. the MT5 Common Files goldflow\bridge.secret, created with `bridge-secret`) or the env var secret_env. Order routing only in the demo profile (demo accounts) or the gated live profile; execution.live_trading_enabled stays false.

risk._doc: Phase 16 pre-trade risk engine. Limits default to backtest.risk (decision D7, PROPOSED) so live trades within what was backtested; values here may only be stricter. Spread/slippage filters in broker points (XAUUSD 2 digits: 1 point = 0.01). block_on_dq cannot be disabled.

ops._doc: Phase 17 operations (docs/RUNBOOK.md). Dashboard is read-only and loopback-only (token via env GOLDFLOW_DASHBOARD_TOKEN). Alerts: data/ops/alerts.jsonl; webhook only if webhook_env names an env var holding the URL. Logs rotate at log_max_mb, keeping log_backups files.
